fields.opponent.shortA/shortM: Opponent restricted-area and non-RA paint 2P attempts/makes
fields.opponent.dreb: This defending team defensive player rebounds; not the opponent defensive rebounds

fields.opponent.teamDreb: This defending team defensive team rebounds

fields.defensivePossessionEnds: Integer defensive possession completions at this lineup
